messages:
alex: Clocking out — quick shift update (tl;dr: user-facing APIs steady, embeddings pipeline had a noisy worker, mitigation in progress).

alex: WHAT I DID:
- Verified 99/95/50 latency dashboards for api-prod and embeddings.
- Applied temporary autoscaler tweak for kvcache to reduce eviction churn.
- Restarted embed-ingest-2 after OOM loopback.

alex: BLOCKERS / CURRENT INCIDENTS:
- eu-embed-3 showing elevated p95 (~20-30% above baseline) on small-batch traffic since ~02:10 UTC. No 5xxs but degraded tail latency for regen paths.
- Host metrics show short io_wait spikes on node hosting eu-embed-3. No disk full.

mira: Are alerts firing? Which alert?

alex: opsbot: Current alerts: embed-p95-eu > 250ms (firing for eu-embed-3). No paged incident yet.

opsbot: Alert: embed-p95-eu (eu-embed-3) breached threshold at 2026-03-17T02:12:08Z — severity: warning.

sam: If it's host-level io_wait, first try cordon + recreate pod on different node. If that doesn't help, drain node for deeper investigation.

alex: Doing that now. Command I ran: 
```bash
kubectl cordon eu-embed-3-node
kubectl delete pod embed-eu-3 --namespace=prod --grace-period=30
```
Started replacement; watching health checks.

deploy-bot: Deploy bot: Replacement pod embed-eu-3-v2 scheduled on node g5-ssd-02, image: embed-service:2026.03.16-rc7. Healthchecks passing (liveness, readiness).

mira: Nice. After replacement, can you run a quick synthetic regen sweep against EU to verify p95 back to baseline? small set of 20 queries is fine.

alex: Will run synthetic now. Quick output: 20/20 successes, p50 80ms, p95 210ms (baseline ~180ms) — trending down.

sam: Sounds like transient host issue. Followups: add node-level io_wait alert and add a runbook step to prefer recreate pod before paging.

alex: Agreed. I'll add runbook note and open PR for alert tweak. PR draft: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/alerts/pull/789 (WIP)

mira: Also ping infra to look at node g5-ssd-02 io profile if this reoccurs.

alex: Next steps before I sign off:
- Monitor eu embed p95 for next 30m (I've set a dashboard panel alert to 5m).
- Create post-shift ticket with short summary + attach logs from eu-embed-3 node.
- Open PR for alert threshold and runbook step.

sam: Thanks. One small ask: can you also include the kube events snippet in the ticket? hah, those are gold when troubleshooting.

alex: Yep, included. Example snippet I saved: 
```
Events:
  Normal  Killing  2m   kubelet  Stopping container embed-ingest (OOMKill)
  Warning BackOff  1m   kubelet  Back-off restarting failed container
```

mira: Great. I'll keep an eye for any regressions from my side. If p95 creeps again, I'll escalate. :thumbsup:

alex: Leaving final note in #runbooks/embed-latency: "If single worker hits p95+ and host io_wait > 10%: cordon->delete pod -> monitor 30m, then escalate to infra if persistent."

alex: Signing off — handover to nightwatch. Ping me if it regresses, otherwise I expect stable. :wave:
